transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because after I have these eating episodes, I just feel really gross and disappointed in myself. I keep thinking I should have more control than that, and then I end up writing really awful things about myself in my journal.
Do you ever hurt yourself physically or engage in behaviors like purging or excessive exercise after these eating episodes?
I don’t really know. I mean, I feel bad afterward, but I’m not sure I’d say I do those things.
Can you clarify if you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or hurt yourself on purpose after eating?
I’m not really sure. I feel awful after, but I don’t think I can clearly say I do those specific things.
Have you ever intentionally hurt yourself, like cutting or burning your skin, after eating?
I don’t think so. I’ve felt really upset with myself after eating, but I can’t say I’ve cut or burned myself or anything like that.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or exercise excessively to try to control your weight or shape?
I’m not sure. I feel really guilty after, but I don’t think I make myself throw up or use laxatives. I don’t really exercise a lot afterward either.

Can you describe what happens during these eating episodes? Do you feel like you’re eating a larger amount of food than most people would in a short period of time, and feel like you can’t stop yourself once you start?

Yeah… I think it is more than most people would eat in that amount of time. Once I start, it’s like I just keep grabbing the next thing without really deciding to. I’ll be thinking, like, “Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,” but I don’t actually stop until the food is gone or I feel really uncomfortable.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress or interfere with things like work, school, or relationships?

Yeah, it does bother me a lot afterward. I still usually make it to my cleaning shifts and design stuff, so I’m not missing everything, but the next day I feel distracted and really ashamed. Sometimes I put off sketching because I don’t want to look back at the journal entries I wrote after it happened.
How often do these eating episodes happen? Do they feel like something that’s happening regularly, or are they more occasional?

It’s been pretty regular, yeah. For the past several months, there’s usually at least one night a week where I’ll buy too much food after work and eat it all in one stretch. I can’t really think of a recent month where it stopped for more than maybe a week or so.
After these eating episodes, do you ever fast, restrict your food intake, or significantly cut calories to make up for the food you ate?

I don’t really know. I don’t think I’m doing anything planned like that. Sometimes I might eat less the next morning because I feel gross or guilty, but I haven’t been, like, setting strict rules or counting calories to make up for it.
After these eating episodes, do you feel particularly guilty or distressed specifically about your body shape or weight?
I’m not really sure. I do feel guilty and upset afterward, but I don’t know if it’s specifically about my weight or shape. It’s more just feeling ashamed that I did it again.
Do you ever feel particularly upset or worried about your body shape or weight, even outside of these eating episodes?
I’m not sure. I mean, I don’t love how I look sometimes, but I don’t think I’m constantly worrying about my weight or shape. It’s more that I feel bad after I eat like that.
Would you say you feel a strong sense of distress or preoccupation about your body shape or weight, even when you’re not having one of these eating episodes?

I don’t think so. I mean, I can feel self-conscious sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m really preoccupied with my shape or weight when I’m not in one of those moments. It’s not something I’m thinking about all day.
During these eating episodes, do you feel like you’re not in control of your eating — like you can’t stop eating or change what you’re eating, even if you want to?

Yeah. Once I start, it feels like I just keep reaching for the next thing without really deciding to. Even if I’m thinking, like, “Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,” I still don’t stop. Usually it’s not until the food is gone or I feel too uncomfortable.
Would you say that during or after these eating episodes, you feel particularly upset or worried about your body shape or weight?

I don’t know that it’s really about my body shape or weight in that moment. Afterward I mostly just feel upset with myself for eating that way. I’m not usually sitting there worrying about how I look, exactly.

Would you say that during these episodes, you feel like you’re not in control of your eating — like you can’t stop even if you want to — but you don’t do anything like purging or restricting afterward to make up for it?

Yeah, that’s pretty much how it feels. Once I start, I keep grabbing the next thing almost automatically. I can be thinking, “Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish,” but I still don’t actually stop until the food is gone or I feel too uncomfortable.
Would you say you feel a strong sense of distress specifically about your body shape or weight during or after these eating episodes?

I’m not really sure I’d say it’s specifically about my body shape or weight. I feel bad after, like ashamed or frustrated with myself, but I haven’t noticed it being focused on how I look or a number on the scale.
